description: This file contains implementations of in-memory repositories for users and recipes, including data models, interfaces, seed data, and search functionality, used within the RecipeBackend.Services namespace.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with username, password hash, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: Interface defining user repository operations such as creation, validation, and existence check.

classes.name: InMemoryUserRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of IUserRepository, handling user storage and credential validation.

classes.name: IRecipeRepository
classes.description: Interface defining recipe storage operations such as add, get, update, delete, and search.

classes.name: InMemoryRecipeRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of IRecipeRepository with seed data and search functionalities.

methods.name: TryCreateUser
methods.description: Attempts to create a new user with specified username and password, returns success status.

methods.name: ValidateCredentials
methods.description: Validates user credentials by comparing stored password hash with provided password.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the repository.

methods.name: HashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password using SHA256 algorithm.

methods.name: SlowEquals
methods.description: Performs a constant-time comparison of two strings to prevent timing attacks.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new recipe to the repository and assigns it a new GUID and timestamps.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its GUID, or null if not found.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all recipes ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe; returns false if the recipe does not exist.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a recipe by its GUID.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Filters recipes based on optional query, ingredient, and tag parameters.
